authority: Owner requested detailed review and implementation of a sustainable AI-assisted product delivery scaffold.
scope: Task definitions, evidence archive and source identity
Harness execution, toolchain checks and CI workflow
Product scenarios, feedback, context and release readiness

strengths.finding: Cross-language protocol types and operation projections have one canonical schema and shared test vectors.
Historical task evidence records actual commands, environment, source and log digests.
Unimplemented operations, simulated data, native Windows acceptance and real-service boundaries are explicit.
The existing architecture keeps domain ownership, runtime authorization and external integration replaceable.

findings.observation: Timeout handling discards captured output and subprocess.run does not explicitly terminate the check process group.
Decision metadata is excluded from the execution digest, and current milestone display does not require current task definitions.
Milestone-sized tasks lack focused delivery context, observable scenario bindings and a tracked correction loop.
Accepted history preservation is specified but has no comparison with the reviewed Git base.
Inherited Cargo workspace aliases can hide forbidden infrastructure or internal-layer dependencies from the original boundary check.
The original default harness would eventually run packaged and soak checks on every native change, while the stability timeout was shorter than the contractual two-hour workload.

remaining_delivery_gaps.gap: No current passing native Windows x64 report; CI definition and Linux tests cannot establish it.
Actual market fixtures and their financial/time semantics are not implemented; establish independent expected values before chart integration.
Persistence, operation authorization, idempotency, undo, migrations and recovery need executable end-to-end behavior.
Versioned replay evaluation and observed owner collaboration feedback are needed before claiming useful AI product behavior; mock acceptance does not establish real-model quality.
Installer, packaged workers, clean-machine behavior, artifact identity, dependency/license review, backup/restore and stability evidence remain unimplemented.

governance_limits: Schema checks validate record consistency; they cannot prove semantic correctness or replace product observation.
Source and log hashes detect drift but do not authenticate forged evidence or preserve uncommitted source bytes.
Accepted-history checks need an available Git base; the pre-existing uncommitted scaffold cannot supply earlier committed history.
Import and dependency checks enforce declared boundaries, not a security sandbox for hostile code.
The timeout cleanup regression runs on each available host; Windows behavior requires an actual native run.
workflow_choice: Keep one repository-local operating loop in AGENTS, validated JSON and executable commands. Extract a skill only when a demonstrated repeated procedure needs it; avoid duplicating rules or introducing an external workflow dependency without a concrete need.

validation.historical_baseline: Pre-existing accepted tasks and decision records match the local start-of-review snapshot. HEAD predates those uncommitted records; Git history comparison preserved zero existing records at that base.

primary_references.use: Process timeout, output handling and process-group behavior.
Select the actual review base and manually requested validation profile.
Retain per-run artifacts while keeping historical receipts and release evidence responsibilities explicit.
